english: The year is 2157. This was once Los Angeles—a city of dreams, flying cars, holographic wonders, and boundless innovation.
spanish: El año es 2157. Esto fue una vez Los Ángeles: una ciudad de sueños, coches voladores, maravillas holográficas e innovación ilimitada.
eurofrench: Nous sommes en 2157. C'était autrefois Los Angeles, une ville de rêves, de voitures volantes, de merveilles holographiques et d'innovations illimitées.
brazilianportuguese: O ano é 2157. Esta era outrora Los Angeles — uma cidade de sonhos, carros voadores, maravilhas holográficas e inovação sem limites.
german: Wir schreiben das Jahr 2157. Dies war einst Los Angeles – eine Stadt der Träume, fliegender Autos, holografischer Wunder und grenzenloser Innovation.
italian: L'anno è il 2157. Questa un tempo era Los Angeles: una città di sogni, auto volanti, meraviglie olografiche e innovazione senza limiti.
polish: Jest rok 2157. To kiedyś było Los Angeles – miasto marzeń, latających samochodów, holograficznych cudów i nieograniczonych innowacji.
arabic: عام 2157. كانت هذه مدينة لوس أنجلوس ذات يوم - مدينة الأحلام، والسيارات الطائرة، والعجائب المجسمة، والابتكار اللامحدود.
turkish: Yıl 2157. Burası bir zamanlar Los Angeles'tı; hayaller şehri, uçan arabalar, holografik harikalar ve sınırsız yeniliklerin şehri.
japanese: 西暦2157年。ここはかつてロサンゼルスだった。夢と空飛ぶ車、ホログラフィックの驚異、そして限りないイノベーションの街。
korean: 때는 2157년. 이곳은 한때 로스앤젤레스였다. 꿈과 하늘을 나는 자동차, 홀로그램의 경이로움, 그리고 무한한 혁신의 도시.
mandarin: 时间是2157年。这里曾经是洛杉矶——一座充满梦想、拥有飞行汽车、全息影像奇观和无限创新的城市。
hebrew: השנה היא 2157. זו הייתה פעם לוס אנג'לס - עיר של חלומות, מכוניות מעופפות, פלאים הולוגרפיים וחדשנות אינסופית.

english: But everything changed when the Xelthara Collective arrived. Advanced. Ruthless. Unstoppable.
spanish: Pero todo cambió con la llegada del Colectivo Xelthara. Avanzados. Despiadados. Imparables.
eurofrench: Mais tout a changé avec l'arrivée du Collectif Xelthara. Avancé. Impitoyable. Invincible.
brazilianportuguese: Mas tudo mudou com a chegada do Coletivo Xelthara. Avançado. Implacável. Imparável.
german: Doch alles änderte sich, als das Xelthara-Kollektiv eintraf. Hochentwickelt. Gnadenlos. Unaufhaltsam.
italian: Ma tutto cambiò con l'arrivo del Collettivo Xelthara. Avanzato. Spietato. Inarrestabile.
polish: Ale wszystko zmieniło się wraz z przybyciem Kolektywu Xelthara. Zaawansowany. Bezwzględni. Niepowstrzymani.
arabic: لكن كل شيء تغير عندما وصلت جماعة زيلثارا. متطورة. لا ترحم. لا يمكن إيقافها.
turkish: Ama Xelthara Kolektifi geldiğinde her şey değişti. Gelişmiş. Acımasız. Durdurulamaz.
japanese: しかし、ゼルサラ・コレクティブが現れたことで、すべてが変わった。先進的。冷酷。止められない。
korean: 하지만 젤타라 집단이 나타나면서 모든 것이 바뀌었습니다. 고도로 발전했고, 무자비했으며, 막을 수 없는 존재들이었습니다.
mandarin: 但当塞尔塔拉联盟到来后，一切都改变了。先进。冷酷。势不可挡。
hebrew: אבל הכל השתנה כשהגיע קולקטיב קסלת'רה. מתקדם. חסר רחמים. בלתי ניתן לעצירה.

english: The Xelthara declared Earth 'discovered territory' and humanity 'an inconvenient indigenous population.' Within days, millions were displaced into cramped containment zones while they colonized our cities, dismantled our monuments, and began terraforming our world for their needs.
spanish: Los Xelthara declararon la Tierra "territorio descubierto" y a la humanidad "una población indígena inconveniente". En cuestión de días, millones de personas fueron desplazadas a zonas de confinamiento abarrotadas, mientras ellos colonizaban nuestras ciudades, desmantelaban nuestros monumentos y comenzaban a transformar nuestro planeta para adaptarlo a sus necesidades.
eurofrench: Les Xelthara ont déclaré la Terre « territoire découvert » et l'humanité « population indigène gênante ». En quelques jours, des millions de personnes ont été déplacées vers des zones de confinement surpeuplées, tandis qu'ils colonisaient nos villes, démantelaient nos monuments et commençaient à transformer notre planète pour leurs propres besoins.
brazilianportuguese: Os Xelthara declararam a Terra "território descoberto" e a humanidade "uma população indígena inconveniente". Em poucos dias, milhões de pessoas foram deslocadas para zonas de contenção superlotadas, enquanto eles colonizavam nossas cidades, desmantelavam nossos monumentos e começavam a transformar nosso mundo para atender às suas necessidades.
german: Die Xelthara erklärten die Erde zum „entdeckten Territorium“ und die Menschheit zu einer „lästigen einheimischen Bevölkerung“. Innerhalb weniger Tage wurden Millionen von Menschen in überfüllte Internierungszonen vertrieben, während die Xelthara unsere Städte kolonisierten, unsere Denkmäler zerstörten und begannen, unsere Welt für ihre Bedürfnisse umzugestalten.
italian: Gli Xelthara dichiararono la Terra "territorio scoperto" e l'umanità "una popolazione indigena scomoda". Nel giro di pochi giorni, milioni di persone furono trasferite con la forza in zone di confinamento sovraffollate, mentre loro colonizzavano le nostre città, smantellavano i nostri monumenti e iniziavano a trasformare il nostro pianeta per adattarlo alle proprie esigenze.
polish: Xelthara ogłosili Ziemię „odkrytym terytorium”, a ludzkość „uciążliwą rdzenną populacją”. W ciągu kilku dni miliony ludzi zostały przesiedlone do ciasnych stref odosobnienia, podczas gdy oni kolonizowali nasze miasta, niszczyli nasze zabytki i rozpoczęli przekształcanie naszej planety na własne potrzeby.
arabic: أعلنت حضارة زيلثارا أن الأرض "أرض مكتشفة" وأن البشرية "سكان أصليون مزعجون". في غضون أيام، تم تهجير الملايين إلى مناطق احتجاز ضيقة ومكتظة، بينما قاموا باستعمار مدننا، وتفكيك آثارنا، وبدأوا في تغيير بيئة كوكبنا لتناسب احتياجاتهم.
turkish: Xelthara ırkı, Dünya'yı "keşfedilmiş bölge" ve insanlığı "istenmeyen yerli nüfus" ilan etti. Birkaç gün içinde milyonlarca insan daracık karantina bölgelerine yerleştirilirken, onlar şehirlerimizi kolonileştirdiler, anıtlarımızı yıktılar ve dünyamızı kendi ihtiyaçlarına göre dönüştürmeye başladılar.
japanese: ゼルサラ人は地球を「発見された領土」、人類を「厄介な先住民」と宣言した。数日のうちに、何百万人もの人々が狭苦しい収容区域に追いやられる一方、彼らは私たちの都市を植民地化し、記念碑を解体し、自分たちのニーズに合わせて私たちの世界をテラフォーミングし始めた。
korean: 젤타라 종족은 지구를 '발견된 영토'로 선포하고 인류를 '불편한 토착민'으로 규정했습니다. 며칠 만에 수백만 명의 사람들이 비좁은 수용 구역으로 강제 이주당했고, 그들은 우리의 도시를 식민지화하고, 기념물을 파괴하고, 자신들의 필요에 맞게 지구를 개조하기 시작했습니다.
mandarin: 塞尔萨拉人宣布地球为“已发现领土”，并将人类视为“碍事的土著居民”。几天之内，数百万人被迫迁入拥挤不堪的隔离区，而他们则占领了我们的城市，拆毁了我们的纪念碑，并开始改造我们的星球以满足他们的需求。
hebrew: בני הקסלת'ארה הכריזו על כדור הארץ כ"טריטוריה שהתגלתה" ועל האנושות כ"אוכלוסייה ילידית לא נוחה". תוך ימים ספורים, מיליונים נעקרו לאזורי בידוד צפופים בזמן שהם יישובו את ערינו, פירקו את המונומנטים שלנו והחלו לעצב את עולמנו לצרכיהם.

english: They extract our resources, erase our culture, and build their settlements over our homes. But from the margins of these containment zones, four champions emerged—refusing to be erased, refusing to surrender our homeland.
spanish: Extraen nuestros recursos, borran nuestra cultura y construyen sus asentamientos sobre nuestras casas. Pero desde los márgenes de estas zonas de confinamiento, surgieron cuatro campeones que se negaron a ser borrados, que se negaron a entregar nuestra patria.
eurofrench: Ils exploitent nos ressources, effacent notre culture et construisent leurs colonies sur nos terres. Mais aux confins de ces zones d'isolement, quatre champions ont émergé, refusant d'être réduits au silence et de céder notre patrie.
brazilianportuguese: Eles extraem nossos recursos, apagam nossa cultura e constroem seus assentamentos sobre nossas casas. Mas das margens dessas zonas de confinamento, quatro campeões emergiram, recusando-se a serem apagados, recusando-se a entregar nossa pátria.
german: Sie beuten unsere Ressourcen aus, zerstören unsere Kultur und errichten ihre Siedlungen auf unseren Häusern. Doch am Rande dieser Sperrgebiete traten vier Helden hervor – die sich weigerten, ausgelöscht zu werden, und sich weigerten, unsere Heimat aufzugeben.
italian: Estraggono le nostre risorse, cancellano la nostra cultura e costruiscono i loro insediamenti sulle nostre case. Ma ai margini di queste zone di confinamento, sono emersi quattro eroi che si sono rifiutati di essere annientati, rifiutandosi di cedere la nostra patria.
polish: Wykorzystują nasze zasoby naturalne, niszczą naszą kulturę i budują swoje osiedla na miejscu naszych domów. Ale na obrzeżach tych stref izolacji pojawiło się czterech bohaterów – odmawiających poddania się, odmawiających oddania naszej ojczyzny.
arabic: إنهم يستنزفون مواردنا، ويمحون ثقافتنا، ويبنون مستوطناتهم فوق منازلنا. ولكن من أطراف مناطق الحصار هذه، برز أربعة أبطال رفضوا أن يتم محوهم، ورفضوا التخلي عن وطننا.
turkish: Kaynaklarımızı sömürüyorlar, kültürümüzü yok ediyorlar ve evlerimizin üzerine kendi yerleşim yerlerini kuruyorlar. Ama bu kuşatma bölgelerinin kenarlarından dört kahraman ortaya çıktı; yok edilmeyi reddeden, vatanımızı teslim etmeyi reddeden dört kahraman.
japanese: 彼らは私たちの資源を略奪し、私たちの文化を消し去り、私たちの家の上に自分たちの居住地を築き上げる。しかし、これらの封鎖区域の片隅から、4人の英雄が立ち上がった。彼らは消し去られることを拒み、故郷を明け渡すことを拒んだのだ。
korean: 그들은 우리의 자원을 약탈하고, 우리의 문화를 말살하며, 우리의 집터 위에 자신들의 정착촌을 건설합니다. 하지만 이러한 봉쇄 구역의 변두리에서 네 명의 영웅이 나타났습니다. 그들은 말살당하기를 거부하고, 우리의 고향을 포기하기를 거부했습니다.
mandarin: 他们掠夺我们的资源，抹杀我们的文化，并在我们的家园上建造他们的定居点。但在这片被围困的边缘地带，四位勇士挺身而出——他们拒绝被抹杀，拒绝放弃我们的家园。
hebrew: הם מחלצים את משאבינו, מוחקים את תרבותנו ובונים את יישוביהם על בתינו. אבל משולי אזורי הבלימה הללו, צצו ארבעה אלופים - שמסרבים להימחק, מסרבים לוותר על מולדתנו.

english: Ninja Frog—master of speed and stealth. Mask Dude—the fearless brawler. Pink Man—acrobat extraordinaire. Virtual Guy—the digital phantom.
spanish: Rana Ninja: maestro de la velocidad y el sigilo. Chico Enmascarado: el luchador intrépido. Hombre Rosa: acróbata extraordinario. Chico Virtual: el fantasma digital.
eurofrench: Ninja Frog : maître de la vitesse et de la discrétion. Mask Dude : le bagarreur intrépide. Pink Man : acrobate hors pair. Virtual Guy : le fantôme numérique.
brazilianportuguese: Ninja Frog — mestre da velocidade e da furtividade. Mask Dude — o lutador destemido. Pink Man — o acrobata extraordinário. Virtual Guy — o fantasma digital.
german: Ninja Frog – Meister der Geschwindigkeit und Tarnung. Mask Dude – der furchtlose Kämpfer. Pink Man – der außergewöhnliche Akrobat. Virtual Guy – das digitale Phantom.
italian: Ninja Frog: maestro della velocità e della furtività. Mask Dude: il combattente senza paura. Pink Man: acrobata straordinario. Virtual Guy: il fantasma digitale.
polish: Ninja Frog – mistrz szybkości i skradania się. Mask Dude – nieustraszony wojownik. Pink Man – niezwykły akrobata. Virtual Guy – cyfrowy fantom.
arabic: الضفدع النينجا - سيد السرعة والتخفي. الرجل المقنع - المقاتل الشجاع. الرجل الوردي - البهلوان البارع. الرجل الافتراضي - الشبح الرقمي.
turkish: Ninja Kurbağa – hız ve gizliliğin ustası. Maskeli Adam – korkusuz dövüşçü. Pembe Adam – olağanüstü akrobat. Sanal Çocuk – dijital hayalet.
japanese: ニンジャフロッグ――スピードとステルスの達人。マスクド・デュード――恐れ知らずの格闘家。ピンクマン――並外れたアクロバットの使い手。バーチャルボーイ――デジタルの幻影。
korean: 닌자 개구리 - 속도와 은신의 달인. 마스크 맨 - 용감무쌍한 싸움꾼. 핑크 맨 - 뛰어난 곡예사. 버추얼 보이 - 디지털 유령.
mandarin: 忍者蛙——速度与隐匿的大师。面具男——无畏的格斗家。粉红人——技艺超群的杂技演员。虚拟人——数字世界的幽灵。
hebrew: צפרדע נינג'ה - אמן המהירות והחמקנות. אחי המסכה - הלוחם חסר הפחד. האיש הוורוד - אקרובטי יוצא דופן. הבחור הווירטואלי - הפנטום הדיגיטלי.

english: You have been chosen to embody one of these heroes. Join the Homeland Liberation Front—humanity's last stand against colonial occupation.
spanish: Has sido elegido para encarnar a uno de estos héroes. Únase al Frente de Liberación de la Patria, la última resistencia de la humanidad contra la ocupación colonial.
eurofrench: Vous avez été choisi pour incarner l'un de ces héros. Rejoignez le Front de libération de la patrie, l'ultime rempart de l'humanité contre l'occupation coloniale.
brazilianportuguese: Você foi escolhido para encarnar um desses heróis. Junte-se à Frente de Libertação da Pátria — a última esperança da humanidade contra a ocupação colonial.
german: Sie wurden auserwählt, einen dieser Helden zu verkörpern. Schließen Sie sich der Heimatbefreiungsfront an – der letzten Bastion der Menschheit gegen die koloniale Besatzung.
italian: Sei stato scelto per incarnare uno di questi eroi. Unisciti al Fronte di Liberazione della Patria, l'ultima speranza dell'umanità contro l'occupazione coloniale.
polish: Zostałeś wybrany, aby wcielić się w jednego z tych bohaterów. Dołącz do Frontu Wyzwolenia Ojczyzny – ostatniej nadziei ludzkości w walce z kolonialną okupacją.
arabic: لقد تم اختيارك لتجسيد أحد هؤلاء الأبطال. انضم إلى جبهة تحرير الوطن، خط الدفاع الأخير للبشرية ضد الاحتلال الاستعماري.
turkish: Bu kahramanlardan birini temsil etmek üzere seçildiniz. Sömürgeci işgale karşı insanlığın son direniş noktası olan Anavatan Kurtuluş Cephesi'ne katılın.
japanese: あなたはこれらの英雄の一人を体現する人物として選ばれました。祖国解放戦線に参加し、植民地支配に対する人類最後の抵抗に加わりましょう。
korean: 당신은 이 영웅들 중 한 명을 구현할 인물로 선택되었습니다. 식민지 점령에 맞서는 인류의 마지막 보루인 조국 해방 전선에 합류하세요.
mandarin: 您已被选中，将成为这些英雄之一的化身。加入祖国解放阵线——人类反抗殖民占领的最后防线。
hebrew: נבחרת לגלם אחד מהגיבורים הללו. הצטרפו לחזית לשחרור המולדת - העמדה האחרונה של האנושות נגד הכיבוש הקולוניאלי.

english: Infiltrate their colonial territories. Sabotage the power cores fueling their terraforming and expansion. Dismantle their settlement infrastructure. Every zone you liberate pushes back their occupation and reminds them: Earth has inhabitants who will fight for it.
spanish: Infiltraros en sus territorios coloniales. Sabotead los núcleos de energía que impulsan su terraformación y expansión. Desmantelad su infraestructura de asentamientos. Cada zona que liberéis hará retroceder su ocupación y les recordará que la Tierra tiene habitantes que lucharán por ella.
eurofrench: Infiltrez leurs territoires coloniaux. Sabotez les centrales énergétiques qui alimentent leurs projets de terraformation et d'expansion. Démantelez leurs infrastructures de colonisation. Chaque zone que vous libérez repousse leur occupation et leur rappelle que la Terre a des habitants prêts à se battre pour elle.
brazilianportuguese: Infiltre-se em seus territórios coloniais. Sabote os núcleos de energia que alimentam sua terraformação e expansão. Desmantele sua infraestrutura de assentamentos. Cada zona que você liberta faz recuar a ocupação deles e os lembra: a Terra tem habitantes que lutarão por ela.
german: Infiltriert ihre Kolonialgebiete. Sabotiert die Energiekerne, die ihre Terraforming- und Expansionsprojekte antreiben. Zerstört ihre Siedlungsinfrastruktur. Jede Zone, die ihr befreit, drängt ihre Besatzung zurück und erinnert sie daran: Die Erde hat Bewohner, die für sie kämpfen werden.
italian: Infiltrate i loro territori coloniali. Sabota i nuclei energetici che alimentano la loro terraformazione e la loro espansione. Smantella le loro infrastrutture di insediamento. Ogni zona che libererai respingerà la loro occupazione e ricorderà loro che la Terra ha abitanti disposti a combattere per difenderla.
polish: Przeniknij na ich terytoria kolonialne. Sabotuj rdzenie energetyczne zasilające ich procesy terraformacji i ekspansji. Zniszcz ich infrastrukturę osadniczą. Każda wyzwolona strefa osłabia ich okupację i przypomina im: Ziemia ma mieszkańców, którzy będą o nią walczyć.
arabic: تسللوا إلى أراضيهم الاستعمارية. دمروا محطات الطاقة التي تغذي عمليات تحويل الكواكب وتوسعهم. فككوا البنية التحتية لمستوطناتهم. كل منطقة تحررونها تُضعف احتلالهم وتُذكّرهم بأن الأرض لها سكان سيقاتلون من أجلها.
turkish: Onların sömürge topraklarına sızın. Toprak dönüştürme ve genişleme faaliyetlerini besleyen güç çekirdeklerini sabote edin. Yerleşim altyapılarını parçalayın. Kurtardığınız her bölge, işgallerini geri püskürtür ve onlara şunu hatırlatır: Dünya'nın, onun için savaşacak sakinleri var.
japanese: 彼らの植民地領土に潜入せよ。彼らのテラフォーミングと拡張を支える動力炉を破壊せよ。彼らの入植地インフラを解体せよ。君たちが解放するゾーン一つ一つが、彼らの占領を押し戻し、そして彼らに思い知らせるだろう。地球には、地球のために戦う人々がいるのだと。
korean: 그들의 식민지 영토에 잠입하십시오. 그들의 테라포밍과 확장을 뒷받침하는 동력원을 파괴하십시오. 그들의 정착지 기반 시설을 해체하십시오. 당신이 해방시키는 모든 지역은 그들의 점령을 후퇴시키고 그들에게 다음과 같은 사실을 상기시켜 줄 것입니다. 지구에는 지구를 위해 싸울 사람들이 있다는 것을 말입니다.
mandarin: 潜入他们的殖民地。破坏为他们的星球改造和扩张提供动力的能源核心。摧毁他们的定居点基础设施。你解放的每一个区域都将削弱他们的占领，并提醒他们：地球上有人会为之而战。
hebrew: לחדור לשטחים הקולוניאליים שלהם. לחבל בליבות הכוח שמזינות את עיצוב השטח וההתפשטות שלהם. לפרק את תשתית ההתיישבות שלהם. כל אזור שתשחררו דוחה את הכיבוש שלהם ומזכיר להם: לכדור הארץ יש תושבים שיילחמו למענה.

english: But first, you must complete the training protocol. Master the controls, learn your attack techniques, and prove you're ready for combat. The fate of humanity rests in your hands. Good luck, hero. Earth is counting on you.
spanish: Pero primero, debes completar el protocolo de entrenamiento. Domina los controles, aprende las técnicas de ataque y demuestra que estás listo para el combate. El destino de la humanidad está en tus manos. Buena suerte, héroe. La Tierra cuenta contigo.
eurofrench: Mais avant tout, vous devez suivre le protocole d'entraînement. Maîtrisez les commandes, apprenez les techniques d'attaque et prouvez que vous êtes prêt au combat. Le destin de l'humanité repose entre vos mains. Bonne chance, héros ! La Terre compte sur vous.
brazilianportuguese: Mas primeiro, você precisa concluir o protocolo de treinamento. Domine os controles, aprenda suas técnicas de ataque e prove que está pronto para o combate. O destino da humanidade está em suas mãos. Boa sorte, herói. A Terra conta com você.
german: Doch zunächst müssen Sie das Trainingsprotokoll absolvieren. Beherrschen Sie die Steuerung, erlernen Sie Ihre Angriffstechniken und beweisen Sie, dass Sie kampfbereit sind. Das Schicksal der Menschheit liegt in Ihren Händen. Viel Glück, Held! Die Erde zählt auf Sie.
italian: Ma prima, devi completare il protocollo di addestramento. Padroneggia i comandi, impara le tecniche di attacco e dimostra di essere pronto per il combattimento. Il destino dell'umanità è nelle tue mani. Buona fortuna, eroe. La Terra conta su di te.
polish: Ale najpierw musisz ukończyć protokół szkoleniowy. Opanuj sterowanie, naucz się technik ataku i udowodnij, że jesteś gotowy do walki. Los ludzkości spoczywa w twoich rękach. Powodzenia, bohaterze. Ziemia liczy na ciebie.
arabic: لكن أولاً، عليك إكمال برنامج التدريب. أتقن أدوات التحكم، وتعلّم تقنيات الهجوم، وأثبت أنك مستعد للقتال. مصير البشرية بين يديك. حظاً موفقاً أيها البطل. الأرض تعتمد عليك.
turkish: Ama önce eğitim protokolünü tamamlamanız gerekiyor. Kontrollere hakim olun, saldırı tekniklerinizi öğrenin ve savaşa hazır olduğunuzu kanıtlayın. İnsanlığın kaderi sizin ellerinizde. Bol şans, kahraman. Dünya size güveniyor.
japanese: しかし、まずは訓練プロトコルを完了しなければなりません。操作方法を習得し、攻撃テクニックを身につけ、戦闘準備が整っていることを証明してください。人類の運命はあなたの手に委ねられています。頑張ってください、英雄よ。地球はあなたに希望を託しています。
korean: 하지만 먼저, 훈련 과정을 완료해야 합니다. 조작법을 숙달하고, 공격 기술을 익히고, 전투에 나설 준비가 되었음을 증명하세요. 인류의 운명이 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다. 행운을 빌어요, 영웅이여. 지구가 당신에게 희망을 걸고 있습니다.
mandarin: 但首先，你必须完成训练流程。掌握操作技巧，学习攻击招式，并证明你已做好战斗准备。人类的命运掌握在你手中。祝你好运，英雄！地球的未来就靠你了。
hebrew: אבל ראשית, עליך להשלים את פרוטוקול האימון. שלוט בבקרות, למד את טכניקות ההתקפה שלך והוכיח שאתה מוכן לקרב. גורל האנושות מונח בידיים שלך. בהצלחה, גיבור. כדור הארץ סומך עליך.

english: Shattered Aegis of the Void Commander
The Citadel Approach (The High Command Bridge)
ACT II - ARC 1: FRACTURING THE SEGREGATION GRID
ACT II - ARC 2: THE RESOURCE RECLAMATION FRONT
ACT II - ARC 3: DISMANTLING CORPORATE GOVERNANCE

A vast, dark, wireframe grid simulation of a crumbled downtown Los Angeles skyline. Neon blue lines define roads and buildings. Static glitches constantly flicker across the view. The four champions stand on a glowing platform.

The ruins of the Imperial Palace Gardens. Xelthara terraforming beams are actively dissolving ancient stone lanterns and cherry blossoms, replacing them with sterile, obsidian-slab administrative monoliths.

The massive, gated intake gate of Containment Zone 4. Thousands of families are being herded like cattle through energy-fences. Behind them, their suburban homes are being flattened by Xelthara expansion walkers.

The literal Under-City: a network of maintenance shafts beneath a gleaming, neon-lit Xelthara settlement. Above, the occupiers enjoy terraformed air; below, the marginalized humans scavenge for ozone-polluted oxygen.

The shattered remains of the Pacific Defense Hub. The proud, traditional military infrastructure is being recycled by the Xelthara, forcing Siren to coordinate a decentralized network of hidden cells.

The active Sector-4 Separation Grid: a 40-meter-tall energy wall fortified with biometric scanner spires, permit-processing checkpoints, and Xelthara Border Authority stations. It physically bisects Los Angeles, isolating the human containment zone from the Xelthara colonial sector.
The Shado-Grid Spire houses the Population Registry, Property Reassignment Database, and Forced Labor Allocation System: the bureaucratic engine of colonial displacement in the Downtown Core.

Beneath the former Convention Center: Cyber-Grave Labs Sector-Omega-7, a behavioral modification facility deploying neural conditioning implants to suppress organized resistance in captured human community organizers.
The Xelthara Thermal Conversion Array has made the air toxic in a 40-kilometer radius, processing atmospheric waste as off-world fuel while selling humanity's oxygen back in rationed canisters.
The Pacific Ocean is being systematically drained by Deep-Sea Hydrogen Siphoning Conduits. Superheated brine discharge has acidified a 300-kilometer coastal stretch, destroying fishing communities.
The Stratos Docks high-altitude cargo terminal at 4,000 meters processes Earth's strip-mined minerals, ocean hydrogen, and biological samples for permanent off-world export.

Sector 7 Core is the surveillance and enforcement power hub: the computational backbone of every colonial security camera, curfew drone, biometric checkpoint, and predictive detention algorithm on the western continent.

The Sector 7 Checkpoint controls all transit between the northern mountain communities, eastern desert settlements, and coastal containment zones, functioning as a supply interdiction hub that taxes, delays, and confiscates goods.

The Obsidian Vault beneath the former Getty Center archives everything seized from humanity: artworks, linguistic records, oral histories, religious artifacts, and the Original Land Treaty Database, all classified as colonial property.
The final 400-meter fortified bridge over the drained LA River: the only surface-level approach to the Xelthara High Command Citadel, built over the demolished Boyle Heights community.
The High Overseer's throne room: a platform suspended over the burning ruins of Neo-LA, where the supreme commander of the Xelthara colonial occupation awaits the final confrontation.
The Xelthara Mothership's Singularity Engine chamber: a chamber of pure unstable energy at the heart of the collective's power, where the Collective Will itself manifests.
Complete the training protocol by cycling through all movement and combat abilities, culminating in a simultaneous squad attack to destroy a simulated Xelthara Heavy Unit.
Infiltrate the active demolition site to retrieve the Data-Blade before the Xelthara Culture-Erasure field purges the site's memory forever.
Hold the Last Bridge against Xelthara Enforcers, allowing a final group of refugees to slip into the unmapped slums instead of the gated camps.
Siphon energy from the colonial grid to power the marginalized population's life-support systems, while evading the Purity Patrols hunting for human strays.
Dismantle the last standing military broadcast tower and distribute its frequency chips to civilian resistance cells, finalizing the transition to guerrilla warfare.

Disable all four biometric scanner spires, destroy the central Permit Processing Core, and bring down the Great Separation so the population of the containment zones can walk freely through their own city.
Steal the complete property and population registry datasets before off-world transmission, and corrupt the Forced Labor Allocation System to nullify all pending assignment orders.
Extract the Conditioning Protocol Archive and destroy the Central Neural Uplink to restore neural autonomy to hundreds of conditioned individuals in the containment zones.
Reverse the Thermal Conversion Array's polarity to trigger a cascade thermal implosion, permanently destroying the foundry and allowing the 40-kilometer atmospheric damage zone to begin recovery.
Locate and destroy the three primary Deep-Sea Siphon Conduit Hubs to permanently halt ocean extraction and begin oceanic recovery.
Hijack Transport T-14, redirect its cargo to Liberation Front distribution points, and destroy the four Anti-Air Turrets to permanently open a flight corridor for resistance supply runs.
Initiate a catastrophic overload of Sector 7 Core's processor array to cause a continental-scale security grid blackout, giving the resistance 72 hours of unmonitored movement.
Coordinate a popular uprising of 847 civilian resistance participants to permanently seize the Sector 7 Checkpoint and establish it as the first liberated transit hub under human control.
Infiltrate the Obsidian Vault, extract the Original Land Treaty Database and all cultural archives, and destroy the physical catalogue system to halt the colonial cultural processing pipeline.
Push across the 400-meter bridge under sustained artillery fire to reach the Citadel's entrance gate: a relentless grinding advance using Ronin's shield and Siren's drone barrage.
Defeat the Xelthara High Overseer using the Axiom Force's combined Ultimate Protocols in a coordinated final assault.
Destroy the Collective Will's Singularity Engine core by coordinating generator overloads and a final combined strike before the mothership completes its erasure of Earth.
